SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS n_distinct, MIN(o.order_ts_utc) AS mn, MAX(o.order_ts_utc) AS mx
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS test_orders
FROM fact_web_order o
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' AND p.category = 'ZZ Test'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS web_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
  AND CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
